1.3.1.description:
- Feat: Added a version notification modal. Provides descriptions on new updates.
- Fix: Empty list label now sticks to the center.
- Fix: Updated how reparenting is recorded through ChangeHistoryService, using the newer methods.

1.2.3.description:
- Fix: Improved reparenting performance. Temporarily waits for next scheduler step to prevent timeout exhaustion.
- Fix: Watches folder’s ancestry for changes, removes and rebuild’s pinned folders list upon deletion/removal.
- Fix: No longer watches workspace descendant removals for pinned folders.

1.2.0.description: - Feat: Reparent toolbar button. Useful for quick access / keybind shortcuts.

1.1.1.description: - Fix: Changed the pinned list’s VerticalAlignment to Top instead of Center.

1.1.0.description: - Feat: “Clear Pinned” button to clear pinned folder list.
